_comment: ATMOSPHERE profiles (plan-region-atmosphere.md A1) — the AIR over an area, not the ground under it. Worn ONLY by zone.atmospheres; the ground is the sibling file, terrain-profiles.json. ⭐ The two tables are SEPARATE on purpose (PO 2026-09-15): they used to share one file and therefore one Tiled dropdown, so naming a ground profile on an atmosphere drew nothing and naming an atmosphere profile on a region painted grey mud — L15, and it cost a session. Now Tiled offers AuraAtmosphereProfile here and AuraProfile there, and neither mistake is a dropdown entry. ⚑ Same lookup engine, same D0 transparency rule, same D14 colour fallback as terrain — a profile is still just a named bag of presentation properties.
_comment_air: ⭐ THE AIR IS TWO THINGS, and which one you author decides how it behaves (PO 2026-09-14, replacing the single `gloom`). `darkness` is the ABSENCE OF LIGHT: a lantern removes it by definition, so it is drawn where the light holes erase it, and it is COLOUR ONLY — never textured, never drifting. `haze` is SUSPENDED MATTER (fog, smoke, dust): a lamp shows it to you rather than dispersing it, so it lives in its own layer that nothing erases, and it is the half that carries `texture`, `scale`, `blend` and `scroll`. ⚑ Haze draws UNDER darkness, so fog is only visible where there is light to see it by — an unlit smoky cave reads black and its fog appears in the lantern pocket. ⭐ Authoring BOTH is the smoky cave and is supported; their opacities COMPOUND rather than max (0.8 darkness under 0.4 haze reads about 0.88 unlit). ⭐ `0` is NOT the same as omitting: 0 is an authored CLEARING that ERASES that layer (D3), while omitting the key means no opinion and draws nothing at all — which cost a session when removing the key made a whole fog bank vanish rather than go pale. ⚑ Every number here is [PLACEHOLDER] and is exactly what the look sitting is for.
_comment_sight: `sight` (plan-region-atmosphere.md A2) is how far the local player sees UNAIDED inside this air, in WORLD UNITS. Unlike the two dials above it resolves PER POINT at the player rather than per shape — §3.1 is why getting the two the wrong way round is the trap. ⭐ D7: it can only ever make a place KINDER, because the hole is max(wire light_radius, sight) and never a replacement, so an atmosphere cannot cancel a Lantern. For scale against a 20 x 12 unit screen: Lantern is r 4.0 (+0.5/level), Torch 2.5, a campfire 7.0 — so ~2 reads as 'grope forward' and much past ~8 stops being darkness at all. Nothing shipped authors it yet.
_comment_fog_tile: `fog-placeholder` is generated by tools/make-fog-tile.mjs (deterministic, re-runnable, seam proven rather than eyeballed), the same posture as the water tile. ⚑ It is the ONLY RGBA tile in the ground directory, on purpose: `haze` applies ONE opacity to a whole shape, so a fully opaque tile at haze 0.6 is a flat wash — the tile's own varying alpha is what gives thick banks and thin wisps inside a single authored polygon.
